newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Honduras policeman killed in kidnap rescue attempt.
newsitem.headline: Honduras policeman killed in kidnap rescue attempt.

text.p: A police officer was killed on Friday in a daring but failed attempt to free a beer executive who was kidnapped in northern Honduras, police said.
"Lt. Gaspar Osorio died from several shots to the chest upon initiating the operation to rescue Mr. Guillermo Villatoro," police spokesman Capt. Danilo Orellana said.
Villatoro, treasurer of the brewing company Cerveceria Hondurena, was kidnapped last Saturday from a northern Honduras ranch. His kidnappers have demanded a $400,000 ransom.
"The operation continues," Orellana said. "Forty sharpshooters have been sent to the scene in hopes of rescuing Guillermo Villatoro alive."
Police and a special urban counterinsurgency force are working jointly on the case in the Lancetilla region about 110 miles (180 km) north of Tegucigalpa.
On Thursday, police captured one of the suspected kidnappers in the port city of Tela, about 110 miles (180 km) north of Honduras.
